imports.title: Import athletes
imports.hint: Upload a list of athletes from CSV or Excel: rows are checked and duplicates found before anything is saved.
imports.rule1: The first row holds headers: Last name, First name, Middle name, Date of birth, Gender, Rank, Assigned on, Order number, Coach email (Russian or English column names).
imports.rule2: Dates as DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD; gender M or F; up to 1000 rows.
imports.rule3: Nothing is saved until you review the preview and confirm the import.
imports.parsingHint: Checking rows and looking for duplicates. This usually takes a few seconds.
